import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

    public void solve() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long base = scanner.nextLong();
        long target = scanner.nextLong();
        int power = 0;
        while (Math.pow(base, power) < target) {
            power++;
        }
        if (Math.pow(base, power) == target) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        long maxVal = (long) Math.pow(base, power);
        long totalSum = (maxVal - 1) / (base - 1);
        if (maxVal - totalSum == target) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }
        if (recursiveCheck(base, target)) {
            System.out.println("YES");
        } else {
            System.out.println("NO");
        }
    }

    private boolean recursiveCheck(long base, long target) {
        if (target == 1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (target % base == 0) {
            return recursiveCheck(base, target / base);
        } else if ((target - 1) % base == 0) {
            return recursiveCheck(base, (target - 1) / base);
        } else if ((target + 1) % base == 0) {
            return recursiveCheck(base, (target + 1) / base);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().solve();
    }
}
